summary: 2026-07-25 08:15:41 PDT — The implementation largely matches the four approved fixes, but it leaves the authoritative Marketplace capability documentation inconsistent with the runtime configuration, and AC1’s prescribed grep still fails because participant-method references remain in client tests. The test gate and npm audit could not be independently rerun in the read-only, network-restricted environment.

findings.title: Authoritative capability list remains out of sync
findings.claim: The diff removes `getMeetingContext` from `ZOOM_CAPABILITIES`, but `server/zoom-app-config.md:112-121` still calls its API list authoritative, says it must match `ZOOM_CAPABILITIES` exactly, and instructs operators to enable `getMeetingContext`. Following that repository guidance would preserve the capability in the Marketplace dashboard, contrary to this change and the spec's required dashboard synchronization.
findings.suggestion: Add `server/zoom-app-config.md` to the approved scope and remove `getMeetingContext` from its capability list, then perform the already-noted Marketplace dashboard removal.

findings.title: AC1's required grep assertion still fails
findings.claim: AC1 explicitly requires `grep -rn getMeetingParticipants client/src` to return nothing, but the command still finds the negative assertion at line 30 and an obsolete fake-SDK `getMeetingParticipants` method at lines 217-220. These are test-only and therefore do not reintroduce the shipped privacy issue, but the branch does not satisfy the stated acceptance check or its claim that the identifier is absent from `client/src`.
findings.suggestion: Remove the obsolete fake-SDK participant method if it is unused, and reconcile AC1 with the intentional negative assertion—either replace it with a production-source-only grep or explicitly exempt test assertions from the acceptance check.
